test_ee_pose: test the robot end-effector pose by comparing actual position and quaternion against desired values
move_to_ee_pose: move the robot end-effector to a desired position and orientation over a specified time duration
move_to_ee_pose_delta: move the robot end-effector by a delta offset from its current pose using delta mode
cartesian_impedance_control: start cartesian impedance control and update the desired end-effector pose incrementally in a loop
get_ee_pose: get the current end-effector position and quaternion orientation from the robot interface
